meta.title: Motorcycle test ads for the rule-based reader, in the same shape as sample-ads.json
meta.method: Nettimoto's labels were read from the rendered text of a public ad page (www.nettimoto.com/yamaha/yzf-r6/…): the same layout as Nettiauto, plus 'Ajoneuvolaji' (vehicle class), 'Moottori' as '600 cm³, 4-tahti', 'Vetotapa' 'Ketjuveto' and 'Ajoneuvon tyyppi'. The page starts with a menu that lists every class in the plural ('Mopot', 'Moottorikelkat', 'Mönkijät', 'Skootterit'), so a reader must not treat those words as the ad's class. The first header price is the current one; the second, struck through, is the old one and can be lower.
meta.privacy: All ads are synthetic except moto-4, which is Vaishnav's own example text. No names, phone numbers or street addresses.
